items.Sentence: Influent is received from the gravity flow collection system at the influent well and pumped to the headworks
the headworks, which includes ... a spiral trash screen
the headworks, which includes a horizontal grit channel
A septage receiving station ... includes a rock trap, grinder, and mixing tank. However, the septage receiving station is not currently used

The Facility’s two oxidation ponds ... are used to reduce biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) and total suspended solids (TSS).
the treatment wetland ... operated to further remove BOD and TSS and provide for biological reduction of nitrogen compounds
Effluent from the treatment wetland is screened prior to entering the ozone treatment system
The ozone disinfection system consists of two ozone generators, an injection system, an ozone destruction unit, and a multi-cell contact chamber
tablet chlorination as a back-up ... calcium hypochlorite tablets are added ... and sodium sulfite tablets are added ... for de-chlorination
the Discharger discharges treated wastewater to a 5-million-gallon, bentonite-lined percolation pond which discharges at Discharge Point 002
If the Facility does not discharge, flow is recirculated (bypassing the disinfection unit) back to oxidation pond one
The Permittee plans to install a septic receiving station to alleviate processing demands on the treatment units.
